business: ArmorHub, a marketplace that sends customers to verified service partners and sellers (partner side)
target: Owners of car-care, tint and protection shops, home-service and beauty providers, and sellers of physical products in Saudi Arabia and Egypt
where: Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Cairo, Giza and Alexandria

behaviours.name: Gets customers by word of mouth and Instagram
behaviours.how: Already has a steady flow and is wary of paying for more.

behaviours.name: Hungry for new customers
behaviours.how: Slow months hurt, would try any channel that brings jobs.

behaviours.name: Dislikes commissions
behaviours.how: Compares any percentage to what they keep by dealing directly.

behaviours.name: Worried customers will bypass the platform
behaviours.how: Expects customers to take their number and go direct next time.

behaviours.name: Paperwork-averse
behaviours.how: Does not want to upload documents or wait for approval.

behaviours.name: Tech-savvy and growth minded
behaviours.how: Likes dashboards, online payments and scheduling tools.

objections: The commission of 10% of every order is too much for my margin
How do I know real customers will come and how many jobs per month?
I do not want to quote blind against my competitors on price
Customers will take my number and bypass the platform next time
When and how exactly do I get paid, and what if a customer disputes the job?
Uploading ID and commercial registration and waiting for approval is a hassle
I already get work from Instagram and WhatsApp; why add another channel?
habits: you take most bookings through WhatsApp and Instagram direct messages
you quote prices by looking at the car or the job first
you get paid in cash or by transfer, usually on the day
you worry about unpaid jobs and customers who change their mind
